current_candidate.summary: WINGS-led repo-local color cutout candidate: BASE and WINGS preserved, black/white line-art candidates replaced by four color Japanese creepy masks (ONI, HANNYA, SHISHI, SHIKAMI), all runtime assets local, fixed orientation, numbered 3x2 portrait controls, adaptive full-stamp renderer preserved.

accepted_asset_direction: 2 WINGS is the current favorite and primary visual reference
real color imagery rather than black line art on white
creepy masks, faces, creatures, strange objects and winged/open forms
strong eyes, horns, ritual/iconic presence are desirable when the silhouette remains readable
open_feedback: Review ONI, HANNYA, SHISHI and SHIKAMI against 2 WINGS as the visual benchmark.
Verify on the target phone that adaptive quality remains visually unobtrusive and all six variants remain easy to discover.
Only promote future candidates if they add stronger color, silhouette or presence than the current set.
resolved_feedback_in_current_candidate: 2 WINGS remains available and is now the default displayed variant.
1 BASE remains available with its accepted full-stamp rendering preserved.
Removed MANTIS/DRAGON/MOTH/OCTO/SKEL line-art direction from the promoted comparison set.
Added four color creepy Japanese mask candidates with strong faces/horns/eyes.
All six production assets live under visuals/trail-lab/assets and runtime performs no external image fetch.
BASE and WINGS were localized using build-time processing that reproduces their previous runtime treatment.
Mask backgrounds were segmented to alpha before promotion; production runtime does not draw museum/background rectangles.
No abrupt horizontal mirror/flip was reintroduced; current six variants use fixed orientation.
Adaptive quality, bounded stamp pool, low internal resolution, high-cadence full stamps and rebound accumulation were preserved.
Portrait mobile exposes all six numbered variants in a visible 3x2 grid.

asset_localization_evidence.alpha_check: all six generated assets reported transparent corners [0,0,0,0]; mask assets reported 22.7%–36.3% near-transparent pixels; BASE/WINGS 48.4%/67.7%
